stem: $\overline{AB}$ and $\overline{CD}$ are two parallel chords in a circle, and the points A, B, D, C lie on the circle in this order. If $AC = ({=a}x + {=b})$ cm and $BD = ({=c}x + {=d})$ cm, find the length of $\overline{BD}$ in cm.
solution: Since $\overline{AB} \parallel \overline{CD}$, the arcs between them are equal: m(arc AC) = m(arc BD).
In the same circle, equal arcs have equal chords, so $AC = BD$.
notes: Legs of an isosceles trapezoid inscribed in a circle. c-a is 1 or 2, so x is a whole number; b-d=(c-a)x.
